Team —

Quick leadership pulse ahead of the Friday QBR: attached is a slimmed headcount slate (hq_headcount_slate_v3.xlsx) and a short succession matrix. I ran a triage pass to propose temporary freezes and immediate backfill exceptions. High level asks:

- Approve the proposed freeze on all non-customer-facing IC requisitions for the next 4 weeks (marked "freeze_temp") unless you mark an exception.
- Confirm the three backfill exceptions I flagged (two infra SDE, one CS mgr) by EOD so we can push reqs to TA.
- If you need a short-term contractor (30–60d) in place of backfill, note that in column F so procurement can pre-clear.

Rationale: we need a controllable runway through the end of Q1 to protect delivery on Platform SLOs and reduce the immediate hiring burn for Dedicated capacity pilots. My suggested approach leans on internal reassignments for low-risk gaps (see succession-matrix-v2.pdf).

Notes on risk: the infra SDE gaps are medium-high for planned infra rollouts; without backfills we will see slower rollout of the autoscaler. The CS manager gap is high for the Acme renewal (Tito Ramos copied below) unless we assign a floating AM immediately.

Please annotate the attached sheet with your decision (approve/deny/partial) and add short rationale. If we don't hear by 17:00 PT I will assume approval of the global freeze with the three flagged exceptions.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP People & Operations | Redwood Inference
